name: Everythings
description:
Most of what an agent tells you disappears. It scrolls up, the conversation ends, and a week later you'd have to dig through chat history to find the plan you made together. Chat was built for talking. Information deserves a better place to live.

The Everythings app is that place. It looks and works like the home screen of your phone: your notes, lists, plans, and projects are tiles you tap, nest, and rearrange. Since everything sits in front of you as small arranged pieces, you can take in a whole plan at a glance instead of rereading paragraphs.

With this connector, Claude works directly inside that space:

• Ask Claude to research a trip, draft a plan, or build a list. The result lands as a tile in your workspace, where you'll actually see it again.

• Claude can search everything you've saved, check what changed recently, file new items where they belong, and tidy up a workspace that has gotten messy.

• You can comment and react on what Claude adds, and so can your family or team. Everyone shares the same space on web, iOS, and Android.

Everything Claude makes for you stays there, ready the next time you open the app.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Everythings to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Everythings to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.everythings.app/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Everythings MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Everythings lists 26 MCP tools, including add_comment, add_mark, copy_thing, create_thing, create_workspace, delete_thing, fetch, get_thing, get_thing_view, get_workspace, get_workspace_view, and list_child_things.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Everythings?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Everythings in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Everythings requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Everythings is developed by Vis Media. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
